questions.question: Against which nation is the oracle in Jeremiah 46?
What reassurance does God give Jacob (Israel) at the end of Jeremiah 46?
options: Fear greatly, for I will utterly destroy you in my wrath
Fear not, for I am with you; I will not make a full end of you
Flee and wander for ever among the distant nations
You are forgotten and cast off from before my face
questions.answer: Fear not, for I am with you; I will not make a full end of you

questions.question: Jeremiah 46 foretells that Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar would strike Egypt.
Fear not, O Jacob my servant, declares the LORD, for I am with _____.
The oracle concerning _____, about the army of Pharaoh Neco at Carchemish.
